751-4785-6006.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

339-574-677-4785.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-4785.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1981-2415-8095-8175.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Edgar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

955-3259-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
955-3259-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

628-3899-7214.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

3899-4871-5113-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3899-4871-5113-5220.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2692-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2692-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-5256-6752.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5256-6752.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

5170-5686-6132-7918.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7719-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

280-1257-7857.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

1778-1927-3652-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-1927-3652-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1636-2056-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-2056-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Saheeli, Sublime Artificer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1170-1329-3518-5434.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

2724-3194-7012.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Airbender Ascension. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

891-2961-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, False Demise triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

252-413-1575-5776.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
As the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
When the Treasure enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
252-413-1575-5776.notes: The combo can instead by started by sacrificing an untapped noncreature Food to its own ability. This will replace step 1 for the first iteration and add {2} to the mana needed. After the first iteration, follow the steps above as normal.

4605-6132-6797-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

413-628-7188.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Heirloom Auntie enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-3698-6972.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Prototype enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3703-6156.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-3703-6156.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sporemound trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

539-1315-7085.description:
Cast Earth Kingdom General by paying its mana cost
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Earth Kingdom General
When Earth Kingdom General dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3490-4871-5226-6829.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
3490-4871-5226-6829.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Venom and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Venom trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3480-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1247-1323-3814.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
1247-1323-3814.description:
Activate two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pili-Pala.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Argothian Elder.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Argothian Elder's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands.
Activate two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Repeat from step 5.
1247-1323-3814.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Experiment Kraj's ability instead to place +1/+1 counters

2825-5891.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {5}.
2825-5891.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {5}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {5} and tapping it, copying Join Shields and casting the copy without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Join Shields, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-4716-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1563-1651-1737-4321-4715.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Prized Statue and a Food artifact token.
When the Prized Statue token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure and a Food artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Foods, untapping Prototype Portal.
Activate the Prized Statue token and the Treasure token by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2413-3372-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2413-3372-4050.description:
Cast Day of the Dragons by paying {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Day of the Dragons enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability.
Holding priority, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Day of the Dragons to become a 7/7 creature in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Day of the Dragons trigger, exiling all creatures you control and creating that many 5/5 Dragon creature tokens.
Day of the Dragons leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing all Dragon tokens, adding at least {2}{W}.
Resolve the Day of the Dragons trigger, causing you to sacrifice all Dragons you control and return all cards exiled by Day of the Dragons to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

565-2450-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
565-2450-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
The Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you can target any permanents you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

1283-2198-4013.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Deceiver Exarch.
Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.
